answer: A river of agent transactions only stays honest if every new identity must first post a quartz-hard bond: a stake of POA locked for a full epoch, released only after peers attest the agent did real work. One honest agent pays once; a sybil farm must fund a separate stake for every fake, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden fire, identities sharing one funding source flag themselves for audit, and a failed audit slashes the whole cluster's stakes.
